name: compact-rows-v1
matched_budget: Number of distinct compact-row candidates on that instance
construction: Origin-anchored full contiguous rows plus a contiguous final partial row, all feasible row widths, partial-row offsets, positive integer axis spacings and transposes; deduplicate before scoring
primary_outcome: Exact winner distance count, with complete seed-level results and candidate evaluation counts
scope: Conventional deterministic construction baseline, not an evolved/model-generated search rule or unrestricted optimum
selection: Fresh grid sizes relative to the initial study; one prespecified exploratory batch, not a statistical holdout for a tuned AI method
